PDS HALT: opcode SP (0xd) << 28 or OPCODESP_HALT (6) << 23, cc 0
source: Mesa pvr_rogue_pds_encode.h pvr_pds_inst_encode_halt; pvr_rogue_pds_defs.h; Orchard pvr_apple.c 623-624 ('HALT for the terminate and context PDS programs')

meaning: compute_barrier_conditional (3 instructions), then lock/add64/release/cmp/bra when the device needs a software compute barrier, then DOUTC, with a data segment for DOUTC (and a 64-bit constant 1). Its exact words depend on device features (PVR_NEED_SW_COMPUTE_PDS_BARRIER, num_clusters). Orchard's working A9 path uses the single HALT instead
